title: docs(spec): import job `failed` also covers a job whose every row failed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7PCFNnUR8ZRYzq6dv7Zyh4)_
Fixes #27734

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 spec 里导入任务状态的说明文字：`failed` 不再只写「致命错误中止」，也写明「至少有一行、但没有任何一行被创建、更新或跳过」的任务同样以 `failed` 结束；`error` 字段的说明同步补上这一情形，并重新生成参考文档。
- 为什么改：服务端按裁决 B（记录 6509036166）已在 #27795 合并，全部行失败的任务现在结束为 `failed`；spec 仍说 `failed` 只是致命中止，客户端和 AI 作者读到的含义比实际行为窄。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，没有枚举值、键、类型或导出变化，线上形状不变；回滚即还原这三个文件。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`（`ImportJobStatus` 文档块与两行注释、`error` 的 describe）；`content/docs/references/api/export.mdx`（生成结果）；`.changeset/27734-import-job-failed-wording.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`，预期 14 个产物全部最新。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ImportJobStatus`** (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`). The docblock now states the terminal rule the REST worker applies since #27795: a job that had at least one row and created, updated or skipped none of them ends `failed`, as does a job aborted on a fatal error; a job with no rows, an all-skipped job and a partly-failed job end `succeeded`; a dry run follows the same rule; a cancel wins over both. The `succeeded` / `failed` value comments are reworded to match.
- **`ImportJobProgressSchema.error`**. The describe was "Fatal error message (when status = failed)". It now says it carries either the fatal error or, when every row failed, one sentence pointing at the job's `results`.
- **`content/docs/references/api/export.mdx`**. Regenerated by `gen:docs` (two table rows: progress and results both show the `error` describe).
- **Changeset** `27734-import-job-failed-wording.md`, `@objectstack/spec: patch` (describe text ships in the package).

No enum value, key, type or export changes; the wire is unchanged. The sentence was written from PR #27795's diff (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`: `everyRowFailed = finalStatus === 'succeeded' && total > 0 && created + updated + skipped === 0`, decided after every cancel re-check).

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so no test was added and no ablation applies (prose only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of lane, routed to the seat:** `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-import-job.object.ts:70` still labels the `error` column `Fatal Error`. After ruling B that column also carries the "every row failed" sentence, so the label is stale the same way (note 6512498465). It is `domain:server`, so this PR leaves it alone.
- The `ImportJobStatus` enum-value comments are TS comments, not `.describe()`, so they do not reach the generated reference; the docblock and the `error` describe are what readers of the spec see.

## Verification
